page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical AMD EPYC 9T24 cores running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25% tier. Text processing performance is also strong. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance for cached small-block reads and large-block writes, though large-block uncached reads perform in the lower 25% tier. Cryptographic and compression workloads, such as Redis SET operations and static web serving, demonstrate stable, average-tier throughput.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is the complete absence of local storage, requiring external block storage attachments for data persistence. Additionally, while single-core performance is strong, uncached memory read bandwidth is relatively weak. Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads such as database operations, caching layers, and text processing tasks that do not require local high-speed storage or GPU acceleration.
